why: The 4,650 ms end-to-end and 159,000 ms cold-start rows in results.csv were measured 16 Nov while a distllm inference server from another project was saturating the CPU. This re-measures both on a machine where the contention is recorded rather than assumed away.

full_predict_path.note: still slightly contended; the detector-isolated numbers above are the clean ones

cold_start.note: Cold start is dominated by the MediaPipe graph build. It is paid once inside _init_model(), so it never lands in a scored predict(). Pinning to 8 cores made it WORSE (90s) because MediaPipe wants more.

verdict.per_frame: PASS - 20.3 ms p50 vs 50 ms budget
verdict.per_clip: FAIL - ~600-720 ms for a 32-frame clip; the detector dominates and the classifier is 0.6% of it
verdict.on_device: NOT MEASURED - no phone attached (adb devices empty)
